name: starmans-desktop
description: Starmans Sole House — Electron desktop app (main process + IPC layer wrapping Backend/ and frontend/app/)

scripts.dist:win: npm run download:sqlserver && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run download:sqlserver && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win --publish never

build._artifactName_comment: MUST contain no spaces. productName has spaces, and a spaced filename gets normalised differently by different tools: electron-builder writes hyphens into latest.yml, while GitHub's upload API turns them into dots. That mismatch shipped in v1.0.1 - latest.yml pointed at a URL that 404'd, so every client's update check would have failed. Pinning a hyphenated name here makes the on-disk file, latest.yml, and the uploaded asset all agree.
